metrics.name: Goal and success clarity
metrics.definition: Before work, record the intended outcome, beneficiary, problem or uncertainty, and observable success condition. At completion, assess each as clear, partial, or unknown.
metrics.interpretation: Clarity is a leading process signal, not proof of impact.

metrics.name: Decision latency
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from a material question or uncertainty being recorded to a decision and actionable next step.
metrics.interpretation: Distinguish waiting from active effort. Unrecorded timestamps remain unknown.

metrics.name: Delivery flow and effort
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from agreed success conditions to verified completion, with blocked or waiting time and approximate active effort recorded separately.
metrics.interpretation: Never infer human effort from chat, tool, or build durations.

metrics.name: Outcome and quality
metrics.definition: Assess the pre-agreed success condition against linked evidence, including follow-up defects, reversals, or rework during an agreed follow-up window.
metrics.interpretation: Tests and builds establish implementation behavior, not user impact. Unobserved user outcomes remain unknown.

metrics.name: DevEnv process overhead
metrics.definition: Approximate active effort spent on DevEnv-specific workflow, documentation, measurement, and upkeep; record friction or duplicated work.
metrics.interpretation: Overhead is a cost to consider alongside outcomes, not automatically waste.

evaluations.title: Search the Glossary view
evaluations.beneficiary: DevEnv users looking up a Glossary term
evaluations.intendedOutcome: Find relevant Glossary entries quickly by searching their terms and content.
evaluations.successCondition: A case-insensitive partial query filters entries by term, definitions, examples, or domains; clearing the query restores all entries, and unmatched queries show a clear empty state.
evaluations.baseline: The Glossary has no search; all entries are shown. No comparable historical timing or effort baseline exists.

evaluations.title: Review principle register organization and precedence
evaluations.beneficiary: DevEnv contributors applying repository development principles
evaluations.intendedOutcome: Determine whether the principle register needs clearer navigation/grouping, explicit conflict precedence, or both, and propose only evidence-supported changes.
evaluations.successCondition: Review all current principles and guidance; assess the three checkpoint scenarios; preserve existing obligations and identifiers; present an evidence-backed proposal and unresolved questions for user approval before changing policy.
evaluations.baseline: The principle register is additive and currently has no established priority ranking. Its workflow checkpoint frames navigation/grouping and conflict precedence as separate questions; no changes are approved.
